name: James and John's Coworking Space
title: The CTO org's office
line: Tell James and John what you need. They read the state, plan the run, and hand you the paste blocks. You start the lanes.

brand.font: "Segoe UI Variable Display", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

jokes: James: Easy does it. One lane at a time, and every lane gets a DONE-WHEN.
John: Relax. I read the diff. Twice.
James: Short version first. Then we earn the long one. We move.
John: Smallest correct change. Then coffee.
James: We plan it, you paste it. Nobody starts a lane behind your back.
John: Two lanes in one file is how Tuesdays get long.
James: The gate grades the work. We don't grade our own homework.
